name: Welcome to the N. T. R.
source:
Jonathan “Charmer” Rodriguez is an ordinary high school senior who doesn’t take his studies seriously. Always late for class, he’s seen as a delinquent by the rest of his classmates, who are busily preparing for their college entrance examinations. He hates his life and the whole town, and the closest thing he has to a real friend is Loser Protagonist Marlo “Marlo” Grabe, who just barely manages to rise to the level of Butt Monkey at the best of times. Jonathan is thoroughly miserable.

Then one day, while walking to school, he bumps into Tsumugi Kotobuki, a shy girl whose only friends at the school have already graduated. Whenever Jonathan sees her around school, she’s alone; her classmates scarcely notice she exists, and no one has any interest in befriending her.

No one, that is, except Jonathan, who without even realizing it finds himself taking her under his wing. As he sets out to help her reestablish the school’s drama club, he finds himself connecting (or, as it often turns out, reconnecting) with several other girls from the school. Although he doesn’t care much about them at first — he doesn’t much care about anything at first — he gradually opens his heart to them as they get to know each other better.

[From [url=http://maximumrobertbriscoev2.tumblr.com/post/78534142598/welcome-to-the-n-t-r]official site[/url]]
translation:
喬納森．「魅男」．羅德里格斯是一名普通的高中畢業生，對學習毫不上心。他總是上課遲到，在忙於準備大學入學考試的同學眼中，他是個不良少年。他討厭自己的人生，也討厭整座城鎮；他最接近真正朋友的人，是失敗主角馬洛．「馬洛」．格雷布——而馬洛平時最多也只能勉強達到「受氣包」的程度。喬納森的生活徹底糟透了。

一天，他在上學路上遇到了壽紬。她性格害羞，學校裡唯一的朋友也已經畢業。喬納森在學校裡見到她時，她總是孤身一人；同學幾乎沒有注意到她的存在，也沒人有興趣和她成為朋友。

除了喬納森。連他自己都沒有意識到，他開始主動照顧壽紬。為了幫助她重建學校的戲劇社，他逐漸和校內其他幾名女孩有了來往（或者說，又有了來往）。起初他並不在意她們——其實一開始他什麼都不在意——但隨著彼此更加了解，他漸漸向她們敞開了心扉。
